body:
The latest five Foundations improvements are now published. This records fresh live checks of compound conditions, counted loops, output, interpreter traces and fixed-point state, plus the public first-session guide. No product blocker was reproduced and no website change is proposed.

Ten lesson/viewport cases, twelve guide/viewport cases and 36 behaviour groups pass at 1440px and 390px. Existing code-contrast scanner uncertainties remain visible; ten endpoint measurements pass at 16.8168:1. A deliberately incorrect table expectation fails against the actual public page. The report retains source/response identities, deployment evidence, raw results and captures.

The evidence validator, missing-viewport rejection, all 63 manifest hashes, Ruff, Vale, local links and commit hooks pass. Earlier production/test evidence is linked rather than rerun. Learner effectiveness remains unknown; VoiceOver is skipped at the user's request and physical touch remains untested. Website #749 and umbrella #114/#115/#124 remain open. No further guide expansion is proposed before the first learner trial.
title: Verify recent Foundations lessons on the public site
